title: RawEnvelope v1
description: Wrapper written by every collector to raw.* topics. The source message is kept UNCHANGED in `payload` so the normalizer can be re-run on archived data. Producer: ingest/collectors [R2]. Consumers: streaming/normalizer [R2], ingest/archiver [R2].

native_symbol.description: Symbol exactly as the source writes it (BTCUSDT, BTC-USD, BTC/USD, BTC-USDT). Null for on-chain messages.

ingest_ts_us.description: Wall-clock time the collector received the message, epoch microseconds UTC.

collector_id.description: Pod / process name of the collector.

conn_id.description: Unique id of the WebSocket connection (changes on every reconnect). Used to reason about gaps.

seq.description: Per-connection counter starting at 0. Gap in seq inside one conn_id = collector-side loss.

replay_run_id.description: Set only when the message was re-published from archive.

payload.description: Original message as received (parsed JSON object, or the raw string if it was not valid JSON).
